scope: Six prespecified WPT-source testharness cases: DOM creation/cloning/containment, microtask ordering, URLSearchParams, and WebAssembly instantiation. Window context only. Not a full WPT run.
limitations: Selected before execution; no failing cases are removed from the selection.
This adapter serves unchanged upstream assertions and testharness.js; vendor integration is appended to testharnessreport.js in memory.
Three window wrappers are generated explicitly from locked source and META script dependencies, without the full canonical WPT manifest.
Worker variants, testdriver actions, HTTPS, HTTP/3, visual reftests and the full WPT suite are outside this smoke subset.
The generated JSON is wptreport-shaped custom-adapter evidence, not an official wpt run or a wpt.fyi submission.
